page_title: HOF 1-3 EIN | Hoffenheim v Eintracht Frankfurt 21/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Hoffenheim seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
87' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Philipp Max as he is replaced by Hrvoje Smolcic (Eintracht Frankfurt).
87' The resulting set piece from Hoffenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
84' Jens Petter Hauge (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
80' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Hoffenheim.
79' Hoffenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Corner kick. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity.
78' Here's the change. Anton Stach leaves the pitch and Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) comes on as a substitute.
78' The manager makes a subsitution with Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) coming on for Wout Weghorst.
75' Here is a change. Ansgar Knauff is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Jens Petter Hauge (Eintracht Frankfurt).
75' Substitution. Omar Marmoush leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt).
73' Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
73' The ball goes out of play. Hoffenheim are awarded a corner kick.

73' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
70' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
66' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
65' Substitution. Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) replaces Attila Szalai.
65' Pellegrino Matarazzo prepares a substitution. Maximilian Beier is replaced by Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim).
63' That's the end of the game for Fares Chaibi, who is replaced by Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt).
62' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
61' Attila Szalai (Hoffenheim) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
60' Hoffenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

60' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) produces an accurate shot from the free kick. His promising effort flies towards the right side of the goal, but is blocked by Jens Grahl, who makes a fine save to keep the ball from hitting the net. Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
59' Hoffenheim win a direct free kick in a dangerous mid-range position.

57' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Hoffenheim are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
51' The game is interrupted. Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
48' The ball is cleared after Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) comes onto the pitch for John Anthony Brooks.
46' Referee Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' 1 - 3 Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the top right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
45+1' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
44' The current number of shots on goal is 3:4.
42' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
41' The foul by Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Matthias Jollenbeck.
39' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Jens Grahl is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
34' The linesman signals that Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

29' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
26' The resulting corner from Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) comes to nothing.
23' 1 - 2 Goal! Fares Chaibi feeds Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 1:2.
22' Kevin Vogt (Hoffenheim) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
21' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
20' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Eintracht Frankfurt comes to nothing.

20' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. Eintracht Frankfurt will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
19' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Oliver Baumann is prepared to thwart his effort.
18' Matthias Jollenbeck has a clear sight and sees a foul from Robert Skov (Hoffenheim). Eintracht Frankfurt earn a free kick.
16' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
14' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
14' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Eintracht Frankfurt force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

11' 1 - 1 Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Oliver Baumann is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 1:1.
10' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
10' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
8' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
3' 1 - 0 Goal! Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
3' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) steps up to send the ball in.

3' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) meets a precise pass with a nice touch on the edge of the box and produces a shot to the middle of the goal. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper! The referee signals a corner kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Hoffenheim will have the kick-off.
Matthias Jollenbeck is introduced as the referee for today's match.
